responsibility: Implements GCC’s experimental HTML diagnostics backend. This file defines the HTML-specific diagnostic_output_format, buffering support, and the html_builder logic that translates emitted diagnostic_info objects, metadata, patches, diagrams, and diagnostic_path content into an XHTML document using xml::document/xml::printer, optionally adding CSS/JavaScript resources and embedding state-diagram views derived from diagnostic-event state. It also owns HTML file opening/default naming and the sink-construction entry point used by the diagnostics output-spec parser.
same_name_distinction: Defines the HTML backend’s implementation bodies: the concrete HTML output/buffer classes, html_builder logic, file-opening/default .html creation, sink construction, and HTML selftests. Unlike gcc/diagnostic-format-html.h, it does not just expose the HTML format API and option struct; it provides the executable implementation behind them.
